title: Images
summary: Add pictures with img, write useful alt text, and caption them with figure.

quiz.q: What is the **main purpose** of the alt attribute?
options: To make the image load faster
To describe the image for people who cannot see it
To give the image a border
quiz.explain: Alt text stands in for the image when it cannot be seen: screen readers read it, and browsers show it if loading fails.

quiz.q: Fill in the attribute that holds the image file path.
quiz.explain: `src` (source) tells the browser which file to fetch.

quiz.q: Which alt text is the best for a photo of a girl reading under a tree?
options: A student reading a book under a tree
Image of a photo of a picture
quiz.explain: Good alt text is a short, meaningful description. File names and words like "image" tell the listener nothing.

quiz.q: Click the line that is wrong.
quiz.explain: `` is a void element and never has a closing tag.
